component.name: ProtonShift
component.summary: Configure Proton, gamescope, MangoHud and your Steam library

description.p: ProtonShift is a native Linux tool for setting up and tuning your games. It discovers your Steam (and Heroic/Lutris) library and gives you a clean UI for the things that usually mean editing config files by hand:

ul.li: Build gamescope launch commands (resolution, FSR, HDR, frame limits)
Inspect Proton prefixes and per-game settings

description.p: Built with Qt Quick and Python. Runs well on the desktop and on the Steam Deck in Desktop Mode.

screenshot.caption: Library view with per-game Proton version, launch options, and maintenance tools
MangoHud overlay editor with metric toggles and presets

description.p: New brand: the app icon and in-app logo are now the "broken ring" sigil mark, matching the refreshed protonshift.i4c.studio.
Bug fix: the remove button in the Environment Variables editor now actually deletes the row.
First stable release of the native Qt Quick / PySide6 rewrite.

ul.li: Steam, Heroic, and Lutris library management
Gamepad support and shader cache tools

description.p: First native Qt Quick preview: Steam library browser and gamescope command builder.
